name: Could I get a Fishing Flier?
summary: A Fishing Contest is announced for Booty Bay this Sunday. The flier gives you the tournament rules if you want to take part.

sections.title: Tournament Rules
sections.body: The notice gives you the rules for the Fishing Contest in Booty Bay. The tournament is set for this Sunday, and you can use the flier to learn how it works before deciding whether to participate.

faq.answer: The Fishing Contest in Booty Bay is this Sunday.
The Fishing Contest is in Booty Bay.

faq.q: What does the fishing flier tell me?
faq.answer: The flier gives you the rules of the Fishing Contest.

faq.q: Can I participate in the tournament?
faq.answer: The notice offers the rules if you want to participate in the Fishing Contest.

attribution: In-game quest text: Could I get a Fishing Flier?
